about.heading: A corner café for slow mornings
about.body:
Ember & Oat is an imaginary café created for this website demo. The story, menu and opening hours are sample content written to show how a real small business site could look.

In a real project, this is where the owner tells their story in their own words, and updates it whenever something changes: a new barista, a seasonal menu, a holiday schedule.

image.alt: Barista pouring hot water from a copper kettle into a pour-over coffee filter
